column1: # Experiment 1 — menu session → scheduled Left/Right proportion of the T (S+).
# Changing the session number changes the proportion. session_run (repetition) does not.
#   ratio_label  — label stored in output data (e.g. 10vs90 = 10% Left / 90% Right for T side)
#   w_esq        — left weight in the design ratio (matching-law design weight)
#   w_dir        — right weight in the design ratio
#   n_left       — number of trials with T on the Left
#   n_right      — number of trials with T on the Right
#   n_trials     — n_left + n_right (120 in the current design)
